notes: Hotfix car - the bot no longer misreports its own version or model. Owner report 2026-11-04: asked 'what version', the assistant named a model from a stale upstream config file on the machine and said the product had no verified version number, quoting a machine-absolute path while doing so. Root cause: the system stack never carried a version or model FACT, while the constitution answers identity questions from runtime context only - a rule with no fact behind it produces a confident guess. Fix: every production turn path now injects a [runtime facts] slot (product version read from VERSION at call time, plus the effective model id after per-chat /model overrides and the model router) as the reference slot right before the skill hint; the block instructs the model to answer version/model questions only from itself and to scrub machine paths. Nine call sites wired across mycore/cli, mycore/acp, mycore/service (cron, mission slices, Telegram pipeline - the router now runs before the stack build so the routed model is the one reported) and web/server (usage measurement, webhook, console chat, OpenAI-compatible API); the isolated subagent prompt is deliberately untouched. Also decoupled the release-notice test from the release line with a 9.9.9 sentinel so that block can never fail again on release day. Design notes: docs/design/runtime_facts_design.md.
